The '''National Institute of Statistics''' ([[Portuguese language|Portuguese]]: '''Instituto Nacional de Estatística''', '''INE''') is an agency belonging to the [[Government of Mozambique]] and the principal agency for the collection of statistics in the country. It was created under Presidential Decree nº 9/96, of August 28, 1996.<ref name="i"/><ref name="o"/>
